methodology: Rejection statistic computed from the human review queue (all_queue_records.json). Rejection rate = rejected / (approved + rejected). Reasons are categorized deterministically from the human review note text.
top_rejection_reasons: duplicate / near-duplicate (incl. DUP_VALUE copy-paste across compositions)
composition series out of range / hallucinated variants
wrong value / correct value is different
computed/simulated value not a measurement (AIMD/DFT/MD barrier)
false positive (regex matched wrong context: vacancy/sampling/activation)
